query:
SELECT
        (t.owner_id = $2) AS "is_owner!",
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM admins a
            WHERE a.guild_id = $1
              AND a.member_id = $2
              AND (a.permissions & 1) = 1
        ) AS "is_admin!",
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM bans b
            WHERE b.guild_id = $1
              AND b.user_id = $2
        ) AS "is_user_banned!",
        t.enabled AS "tag_enabled!"
    FROM tags t
    WHERE t.guild_id = $1
      AND t.name = $3
